description: This file defines the APIKey class, which manages API keys for users in the TestLink project. It includes methods to add, generate, retrieve individual, and retrieve all API keys associated with user IDs, and interacts with the database to perform these operations.

classes.name: APIKey
classes.description: A class that manages API keys, extending tlObjectWithDB, providing methods to create, retrieve, and manage API keys associated with user IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the APIKey object, establishes database connection, and sets the user table.

methods.name: addKeyForUser
methods.description: Creates and associates a new API key with a specific user identified by userID.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random API key string, MD5-hashed.

methods.name: getAPIKey
methods.description: Retrieves the API key for a specific user ID.

methods.name: getAPIKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all API keys or those for a specific user if userID is provided.
